evidence: Matches RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies src/httpserver.cpp and src/httpserver.h to handle HTTP connection timeouts.
rationale: Prevents slow-loris style resource exhaustion in the HTTP server by terminating connections that fail to finish requests within `-rpcservertimeout`. The category prioritizes resource exhaustion through the HTTP server, and while the author notes low impact due to RPC binding to localhost by default ('robustness fix rather than a remotely exploitable security issue'), it resolves a concrete denial-of-service vector where trickling clients can indefinitely consume all connection slots.
